usageNotes: Call this before creating or updating a notification matcher to discover which metadata fields (e.g. severity, type, service) and their allowed values are recognized by the cluster. The response is purely informational — no params are accepted and results reflect what the cluster currently knows based on its configured services and event sources. Requires either Mapping.Modify or Mapping.Audit on /mapping/notifications.

examples.summary: List all known matcher field values for use in a new notification matcher

tips: The 'comment' field is optional and provides human-readable context for a value — check it when a value's meaning is ambiguous.
Use the returned 'field' and 'value' strings verbatim when configuring match-criteria in notification matchers via create_cluster_notifications_matcher or update_cluster_notifications_matcher.
Results are cluster-scoped and reflect dynamically discovered values — re-query after adding new notification endpoints or storage services to pick up newly registered field values.
